title: Working for the Albuquerque commissioner and Howard McGhee
summary: The band worked for the county commissioner's club, where trumpeter Howard McGhee joined them; they talk of McGhee at the Berlin festival and check the Arizona claim.

blocks.x: Oh, boy, you know what I mean. Because after I put it all together, you know, and because he wanted to pay my way, you know. He said, 'Oh, I'll pay your way. You don't have to touch your money.' I said, 'Well, man, we got a job here to go on. You going to stand on the job?' 'No, no.' But we went to work for the county commissioner. He had a club down there and also Howard McGee was there.
In whose band?
Came in right after that.
Oh, in Eddie Hill's place?
No, he didn't come in Eddie's place, but he came in town -- oh, not long, right after this episode that happened.
And where did he go to work?
He went to work with us.
Oh, he did?
Uh-huh. Howard came in and went to work with us and --
Where did Howard come from?
Oklahoma. Yes, he's from -- I don't know what town, but he's from Oklahoma. But I think he gives Muskogee, doesn't he?
I think so. I don't know whether he's old enough.
In fact, I saw Howard, you know, in the Berlin Festival, oh, just -- what was that? A couple of months ago, right?
Born in Tulsa.
Huh?
He was born in Tulsa.
Tulsa, huh?
Yeah.
Well, I figured it would be Tulsa or Muskogee, yeah.
You saw him at the Berlin Festival this year, did you?

Yeah, he played there -- he played with -- Howard played with Dexter, Dexter Gordon group. Howard [Charles] and McPherson -- Stitt was supposed to be there, but Stitt didn't make it. Sonny didn't make it.
Where did you -- it says in here to tour Arizona and New Mexico with Eddie Hill. Did you go to Arizona with his band?
With Eddie's band?
: Yeah.
No, never did go to Arizona.
: No, you were in New Mexico.
New Mexico.
